title: ₹1 lakh grows 56% and buys less
description:
Put ₹1 lakh in the bank at 6.5%, with 30% tax on the interest and 5% inflation. After ten years the statement shows ₹1,56,042. It buys what ₹95,796 buys today.
Explore it free: https://mba.rimilab.com/#/mba/macroeconomics
Source: Rimi Lab MBA real-return model.
